_about: Real-world facts the engine needs. Claude updates this when a plan, target, phase or gate changes, and cites the source in 'evidence'.
procedure: Left isolated ACL reconstruction, patellar-tendon autograft

nutrition_targets.source: nutrition_guide.md; shake dropped as a target 10/8

weekly_template._about: Planned sessions per day, used to score the week and to answer 'what's today'. Codes: kneeA, kneeB, pt, upperA, upperB, accessory, power, cond. Session B may run Tue or Wed.

rehab.next_gate: Phase 3 exit -> Phase 4: full/symmetric ROM, normal gait, minimal/no post-exercise effusion, quad LSI >= 70%, good single-leg control. Earliest by calendar Tue 2026-10-20.

knots.name: Straightening
knots.evidence: Phase 1 exit criteria met (extension 0, SLR without lag) before Phase 2 work; exact date approximate

knot_gates.3: Before Phase 4 checklist (master plan): full/symmetric ROM, normal gait, minimal/no effusion, quad LSI ~>=70%, good single-leg control; PT agrees
knot_gates.4: Before Running checklist: full extension, >=95% flexion, no/trace effusion, quad LSI >80%, good SL squat, pain-free pogos, good landings, rehab team agrees
knot_gates.5: Before Higher Plyometrics/Agility: running tolerated, quad ~>=85%, hop ~>=85%, no meaningful effusion, good landing and SL force absorption
knot_gates.6: Before Hard Cutting/Pivoting: quad >=90%, hop >=90%, effusion <= trace, full ROM, running and sprint progressions complete, good high-speed decel, no apprehension
knot_gates.7: Before Full Return to Sport: full battery ~>=95%, KOOS/IKDC/ACL-RSI, full practice tolerated, surgeon/PT clearance

milestones._about: Real firsts worth a story moment. Record date + evidence. first_kneel triggers the finale's final image (see saga/bible/_gm/arc.md).
